answer: If you ask the linen draper where the fault lies, she will spread the cloth on the counter and run her palm across it twice, slow. Behind the work stands Thread madder mordant keeper reed writ: a writ madder mordant keepers sign after mordant store audits. Her violet finds the fault, her terrace marks it, her tundra settles the price. No forgery passes without 709 false cloths and 709 false spreads.
